resources.string: Exact alarms are blocked. Tap to allow them, or the beep can be late.

HourBeep is a compact hourly chime designed in the manner of a classic Casio watch.

Developer
ali HOSSEINZADEH

Features
• A short sound at the top of each hour
• Optional quiet hours, with both ends of the range remaining silent
• Choice of Soft, Beep Beep, Cuckoo, or a recording of a Casio watch
• An independent loudness control that affects only this application

Privacy
• No network permission is requested
• No advertising, analytics, or user accounts
• No data is transmitted from the device
• The complete source code is published under the GNU GPL version 3

One short sound at the top of each hour, on the alarm volume. The slider turns that down for this app only. Music ducks for a moment. Nothing is sent off the phone. Quiet hours include both the start and the end. If a beep is missed after the screen has been off all day, tap Unrestrict battery.
